body: Step into the future of travel with our latest custom creation, a sleek Mercedes Sprinter wrapped in stunning black and gray camo. Designed for adventure, the exterior features an electric awning with LED lighting, all-terrain rims, and a CA-tuned front bumper for durability and accessibility.

Inside, luxury meets functionality with a memory foam queen-size lifting bed by Happijac and a convertible dinette bed upholstered in Sunbrella Chartres Granite fabric. The kitchen boasts an acacia butcher block countertop, induction cooktop, and stainless steel sink, complemented by an Isotherm Cruise 200 refrigerator and freezer. Storage abounds with overhead cabinets, under-counter compartments, and specialized spaces for essentials like the Laveo toilet.

Comfort is ensured with premium insulation, wood-stained ceilings, and dimmable LED lights, while technology supports off-grid living with a 400W solar system, 800Ah Lithium Iron battery, and 3000W inverter/charger. Amenities include a Nomadic X2 AC unit, Espar diesel heater, and rear outdoor shower. The van also features a Weboost cell signal booster, blackout window coverings, and magnetic bug screens for convenience.
